import Mathlib
import Aesop

set_option maxHeartbeats 0

open BigOperators Real Nat Topology Rat

theorem oddPart_strict_decrease_of_not_coprime
  (m n : ℕ → ℕ)
  (hΔ : ∀ k : ℕ, (m k : ℤ) - (n k : ℤ) ≠ 0)
  (h_coprime : ∀ k : ℕ, 0 < k → Nat.Coprime (m k) (n k))
  (h_recurrence : ∀ k : ℕ,
    (m (k + 1) : ℚ) / (n (k + 1) : ℚ) = (2 * (m k : ℚ) + 1) / (2 * (n k : ℚ) + 1))
  (k : ℕ)
  (hbad : ¬Nat.Coprime (2 * m k + 1) (2 * n k + 1)) :
  Int.natAbs ((m (k + 1) : ℤ) - (n (k + 1) : ℤ)) <
    Int.natAbs ((m k : ℤ) - (n k : ℤ)) := by
  have h1 : 0 < (2 * n k + 1 : ℚ) := by
    have h₁ : 0 < (n k : ℚ) := by
      by_contra h
      have h₂ : (n k : ℚ) ≤ 0 := by linarith
      have h₃ : (n k : ℤ) ≤ 0 := by exact_mod_cast h₂
      have h₄ : (m k : ℤ) - (n k : ℤ) ≠ 0 := hΔ k
      have h₅ : (m k : ℤ) ≠ (n k : ℤ) := by
        intro h₆
        have h₇ : (m k : ℤ) - (n k : ℤ) = 0 := by linarith
        simp_all
      have h₆ : (m k : ℤ) > (n k : ℤ) ∨ (m k : ℤ) < (n k : ℤ) := by omega
      cases h₆ with
      | inl h₇ =>
        have h₈ : (m k : ℤ) ≥ (n k : ℤ) + 1 := by omega
        have h₉ : (2 * m k + 1 : ℤ) ≥ 2 * ((n k : ℤ) + 1) + 1 := by linarith
        have h₁₀ : (2 * m k + 1 : ℤ) ≥ 2 * (n k : ℤ) + 3 := by linarith
        have h₁₁ : (2 * n k + 1 : ℤ) > 0 := by
          have h₁₂ : (n k : ℤ) ≥ 0 := by
            exact_mod_cast Nat.zero_le (n k)
          linarith
        have h₁₂ : (Nat.Coprime (m k) (n k)) := h_coprime k (by linarith)
        simp_all [Nat.Coprime, Nat.gcd_eq_right]
        <;> omega
      | inr h₇ =>
        have h₈ : (m k : ℤ) ≤ (n k : ℤ) - 1 := by omega
        have h₉ : (2 * m k + 1 : ℤ) ≤ 2 * ((n k : ℤ) - 1) + 1 := by linarith
        have h₁₀ : (2 * m k + 1 : ℤ) ≤ 2 * (n k : ℤ) - 1 := by linarith
        have h₁₁ : (2 * n k + 1 : ℤ) > 0 := by
          have h₁₂ : (n k : ℤ) ≥ 0 := by
            exact_mod_cast Nat.zero_le (n k)
          linarith
        have h₁₂ : (Nat.Coprime (m k) (n k)) := h_coprime k (by linarith)
        simp_all [Nat.Coprime, Nat.gcd_eq_right]
        <;> omega
    positivity
  have h2 : 0 < (2 * n k + 1 : ℚ) := by positivity
  field_simp [h1, h2] at h_recurrence ⊢
  rw [div_eq_div_iff] at h_recurrence <;> norm_cast at h_recurrence ⊢ <;>
    simp_all [Int.natAbs_of_nonneg, sub_nonneg]
  <;>
    nlinarith

import Mathlib
import Aesop

set_option maxHeartbeats 0

open BigOperators Real Nat Topology Rat

theorem odd_part_noninc_step
  (m n : ℕ → ℕ)
  (h_recurrence : ∀ k : ℕ,
    (m (k + 1) : ℚ) / (n (k + 1) : ℚ) = ((2 : ℚ) * (m k : ℚ) + 1) / ((2 : ℚ) * (n k : ℚ) + 1))
  (h_coprime : ∀ k : ℕ, 0 < k → Nat.Coprime (m k) (n k)) :
  ∀ k u1 r1 u2 r2,
    Int.natAbs ((m k : ℤ) - (n k : ℤ)) = (2 : ℕ) ^ u1 * r1 →
    r1 % 2 = 1 → 0 < r1 →
    Int.natAbs ((m (k + 1) : ℤ) - (n (k + 1) : ℤ)) = (2 : ℕ) ^ u2 * r2 →
    r2 % 2 = 1 → 0 < r2 → r2 ≤ r1 := by
  intro k u1 r1 u2 r2 h₁ h₁' h₁'' h₂ h₂' h₂''
  have h₃ : (m (k + 1) : ℚ) / (n (k + 1) : ℚ) = ((2 : ℚ) * (m k : ℚ) + 1) / ((2 : ℚ) * (n k : ℚ) + 1) := h_recurrence k
  have h₄ : Nat.Coprime (m k) (n k) := h_coprime k (by norm_num)
  field_simp [show (2 : ℚ) ≠ 0 by norm_num] at h₃
  ring_nf at h₃
  norm_cast at h₃
  norm_num at h₃
  <;>
  simp_all [Nat.mul_sub_left_distrib, Nat.mul_sub_right_distrib]
  <;>
  omega
